## Evidence and privacy

- [ ] Evidence is bound to the exact tested implementation commit and artifact.
- [ ] No credential, token, callback, account identity, device serial, private
      content, raw provider data, or unrelated local file is included.
- [ ] Live mutations and temporary resources were reverted or cleaned up.

## Landing checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, ...).
- [ ] Only owned files are staged; unrelated worktree changes remain untouched.
- [ ] Docs and requirements match the shipped behavior.
- [ ] Push/merge approval is current; promotion, tag, RC, release, or deployment
      has separate explicit authorization when applicable.
